description: This file implements the advanced processing functions for handling HTTP chunked transfer encoding within a network message processing system. It includes functions for examining incoming payloads, processing buffer descriptors, handling chunk data, trailers, and closing the message stream. The code is part of the 'HttpMbo Chunked Object' and manages state transitions during chunked data processing.

methods.name: ULONG HttpMboChkExamine(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize)
methods.description: Examines received payload data and determines the message state, primarily returning a 'over-packed' testing state for current implementation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkProcess(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo)
methods.description: Processes a buffer descriptor object, managing states related to chunked transfer encoding, including parsing chunk lines, processing chunk data, and transitioning between processing states.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkCloseUp(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo)
methods.description: Handles the end of message processing, marking the message as complete, releasing resources, and notifying observers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkRemoveCoding(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Removes transfer encoding (chunked) from the message, cleaning up chunk info and buffer queue.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkProcessChunkData(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo)
methods.description: Processes chunk data contained in the buffer, handling partial chunks, appending CRLFs, and detecting the last chunk.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboChkProcessTrailer(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo,PBOOL pbBccIfNotified)
methods.description: Processes trailer headers after the last chunk, determining if trailer is complete and notifying observers.
